import{createSlice,createAsyncThunk}from'@reduxjs/toolkit';import{apiService}from'../../services/api';const initialState={performanceMetrics:{},currentRecommendation:null,recentTrades:[],isLoadingMetrics:false,isLoadingRecommendation:false,isLoadingTrades:false,metricsError:null,recommendationError:null,tradesError:null,selectedAccount:null,lastUpdated:null};// Async thunks
